practicalSkillsWorkflowAgreement.intake: Both independent records inspected all 17 installed skill summaries. A read emil-design-eng and mobile-native in full; B additionally read apple-design. Do not claim that A fully read apple-design.
steps: Before an identity-bearing website milestone, export a versioned actual-size matrix: universal avatar, owned night variant, headers and character-in-content, with intended sizes/grounds and source/export hashes. Each reviewer sees the actual images before the partner's new findings.

Use emil-design-eng's Before/After/Why format to connect each UI or composition observation to an exact image and remedy. Review the whole composition and good defaults, not isolated decorative details.

Carry B's typography check into every responsive handoff: 320px, 390px and desktop wraps, plus a separately recorded enlarged-text pass when performed. Preserve the established wordmark and font system unless the evidence identifies a specific failure.

Use mobile-native to separate capability-based CSS inspection from actual hardware results. Engineers check hover gating, input sizing and zoom/scroll behavior; identity reviewers inspect framing and hierarchy. Label browser-width, physical-phone and assistive-technology evidence distinctly.

For further night reduction work, compare masked native-size variants on actual intended surrounds, retain the current asset as a control, and prefer supported-size or placement decisions before paint changes. Reject anatomy inflation.

Keep human association/recall, normal-speed motion perception and measured runtime performance separate from static craft scores. A successful checklist or unanimous agent vote cannot substitute for those observations.
exceptions: UI duration and keyboard-feedback guidance does not truncate intentional character acting; the performance is requested content.
GPU guidance does not authorize deleting tiny anatomy or facial paths. Profile a real bottleneck before changing the rig.
Apple typography principles can inform wrap and hierarchy checks without adopting Apple chrome, translucency or a different brand typeface.
A scrolling study does not automatically need overscroll suppression, a PWA shell or global text-selection removal. Preserve document affordances unless an actual interaction needs a change.
Reading installed skill summaries is not an instruction to add libraries, run opt-in prototype workflows, or rewrite source during independent review.
